author: buildat
name: ctf
title: Capture the flag
description: Two teams on a mirrored map and a lobby: players stand on a pad and press Ready to start a round, take the flag from the middle and place it in their own zone, where it scores a point every 10 s. First to 3 points wins, or the most in 10 minutes. Opens in edit mode, ready to play and to change.
